definitions.explanation: Matters relating to one's own personal life or situation. Most often appears in the set phrase {一身上|いっしんじょう}の{都合|つごう}, a polite, deliberately vague reason given when resigning or declining without disclosing details.

examples.japanese: {一身上|いっしんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I am resigning for personal reasons.

examples.japanese: {一身上|いっしんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{欠席|けっせき}した→欠席する：22283_kessekisuru⟧。
examples.english: I was absent for personal reasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}えない→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{一身上|いっしんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I can't go into detail, but I've decided to move for personal reasons.

notes:
Almost always used in the fixed phrase {一身上|いっしんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧ ('personal circumstances'), a conventional and intentionally vague reason for resigning, declining, or being absent. It signals that the matter is private and not open to discussion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一身上|いっしんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧: personal reasons; personal circumstances
- {一身上|いっしんじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: personal reasons
